body.estimand_functional: \(\Theta_{\mathrm{fin}}=\Phi(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{free}})=[\min_{p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{free}}}\Phi(p),\max_{p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{free}}}\Phi(p)]\); under the one-unsupported-binary-row assumptions this specializes to \(\Theta=F([0,1])=[L,U]\).

sampling_model.design: Independent repeated complete scenes from prespecified source skeletons; one representative node per supported type--context row is fixed before sampling.
sampling_model.units: Finite source scenes with the relational skeletons in \(Rsrc\).
sampling_model.treatment: The target intervention \(\operatorname{do}(a)\) is fixed; inferential randomness comes from sampled source scenes, not from target intervention assignment.
sampling_model.overlap: Population transfer uses only positive source parent contexts for target-relevant rows other than \(rstar\). For confidence boxes, each prespecified representative source-node parent context is separately required to have positive probability; \(rstar\) remains unrestricted on \([0,1]\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: For prespecified positive-probability representative contexts, construct simultaneous rational coordinate boxes for supported categorical rows, intersect them with row simplices, choose rational \(etahat\), and inflate the center range by the history-adaptive labeled-occurrence radius \(\delta_{\times}=1-\prod_r(1-\epsilon_r)^{m_r}\leq\min\{1,\sum_rm_r\epsilon_r\}\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The complete identification and neural identified-case results are stated for the larger rho-Markovian class, which permits within-instance latent confounding under finite observed domains and uniformly bounded relational-parent multisets.
comparator_promise_table.matched_by: Assumption-qualified sharp-set theorems for the fully Markovian subclass; nonconstant values transfer nonidentification upward, while sharp ranges and singleton identification do not transfer without class equality.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Canonical finite SCMs reduce arbitrary discrete counterfactual sharp bounds to a polynomial program.
Polynomial programming yields numerical sharp or epsilon-sharp bounds and confidence-region relaxations for discrete causal queries.
Untrusted algebraic root certificates can be checked skeptically by verified univariate CAD and Sturm--Tarski computations.
Root counting and interval subdivision decide univariate polynomial relation systems soundly and completely in PVS.
Exact real-root isolation with multiplicities and nonsquare-free inputs has explicit polynomial bit-complexity bounds.
Unnested univariate parametric Markov-chain model checking is polynomial-time after the parametric model is explicit.
A response-signature LP gives tight causal-order bounds and constructs attaining SCMs.

body.tldr: For any finite family of target-relevant unsupported finite-categorical shared rows, the fully Markovian relational causal set is exactly the compact interval obtained as the image of an explicit rational polynomial over the product of the row simplices, and both endpoints have common finite-noise type-shared RSCM witnesses. The one unsupported binary row remains the tractable specialization: derivative-root isolation gives exact algebraic endpoints and the skeptical certificate checks the complete explicit relational instance and endpoint models with polynomial size and checking cost. This sharp interval is for the independent-ground-noise class; the Ejaz--Bareinboim rho-Markovian class is larger when within-instance latent confounding is allowed, so only nonidentification transfers upward automatically. Supported-row boxes use the sharper multiplicative radius \(\delta_{\times}=1-\prod_r(1-\epsilon_r)^{m_r}\), which is no larger than the additive union radius. A treewidth-zero witness with nontrivial query \(B=\{X_1=X_{k+1}\}\), \(F=1/2\), and direct unsupported-row relevance forces \(2^k\) records only because the frozen checker demands exhaustive assignment-level \(Ictx\); compact circuit-level incidence remains open.

project_justification.gap: Complete relational identification does not return the exact compatible causal range after nonidentification, while generic polynomial bounds do not prove that every product-simplex parameter vector is realized by a type-shared independent-ground-noise RSCM or certify the relational derivation and endpoint models.
project_justification.niche: Finitely many unsupported finite-categorical rows admit an exact structural reduction to a rational polynomial on a product of simplices; the one-binary-row case additionally admits efficient exact univariate algebraic certification.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the multivariate structural sharp image with finite-noise endpoint witnesses, retains a sound and complete polynomial-size skeptical certificate for the univariate specialization, and supplies a conservative sampling enclosure using a history-adaptive multiplicative occurrence-coupling radius.

body.related_work: Ejaz and Bareinboim define the larger rho-Markovian RSCM class, which permits within-instance latent confounding under finite observed domains and uniformly bounded relational-parent multisets, and give complete identification and neural identified-case results there. The present exact image is proved for the fully Markovian subclass with mutually independent ground-variable noises and no shared exogenous parent. A nonconstant image supplies two subclass witnesses and therefore proves nonidentification in the larger class, but neither the subclass interval nor a constant subclass polynomial transfers as a sharp range or point-identification result unless the supplied graph excludes the additional confounding and the classes coincide. Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim provide canonical finite-SCM polynomial programs, and Duarte et al. provide general numerical polynomial bounds and confidence-constraint relaxations; neither supplies this relational product-simplex realization theorem, exact univariate relational certificate, or multiplicative labeled-occurrence enclosure. Li, Passmore, and Paulson, Narkawicz, Mu\~noz, and Dutle, and Tsigaridas and Emiris supply the skeptical algebraic and root-isolation substrate. Hutschenreiter, Baier, and Klein identify a polynomial explicit-univariate model-checking core. Rossetto and Antonucci construct attaining models for order-based nonrelational bounds, but their witnesses do not impose the present type-shared independent-ground-noise semantics.
body.technical_internal_limitation: Efficient exact optimization and skeptical certification of a general multivariate product-simplex polynomial remain open; the complete exact certificate here is univariate. The frozen certificate transaction also requires exhaustive event-consistent assignment records in \(Ictx\). Even for an edgeless target with \(w=0\), the nontrivial query \(B=\{X_1=X_{k+1}\}\), a fair supported \(X_1\), and unsupported-row \(X_{k+1}\) has \(F=1/2\) and direct relevance but forces \(2^k\) records. This is an obstruction to width-sensitive production for the frozen exhaustive grammar only; a circuit-level incidence grammar and checker remain open. The confidence interval is conservative and is not the exact projection over supported-row boxes.
body.honest_scope: Structural soundness, completeness, compact interval form, endpoint attainment, and the finite breakpoint atom-count bound are proved for any finite family of unsupported finite-categorical rows in fully observed, acyclic, fully Markovian type-shared RSCMs. Exact derivative-root optimization, algebraic endpoint comparison, polynomial-size certificates, the sharp optimizer-degree guarantee, and the at-most-two algebraic-noise-mass guarantee remain specific to the one unsupported binary row. The interval is not claimed sharp for the larger rho-Markovian class when latent confounding is allowed. Efficient exact multivariate optimization, compact circuit-level incidence, conditional postintervention queries, exact nuisance-box projection, and empirical usefulness beyond the documented N3 example remain open. The sampling enclosure has simultaneous coverage and uses \(\delta_{\times}\leq\min\{1,\sum_rm_r\epsilon_r\}\); it is deliberately conservative. As sanity reductions, \(F(q)=q\) gives \([0,1]\), while a constant \(F\) gives a singleton only for the stated fully Markovian class unless the comparator classes coincide.
